project: KAMPS (Kenya Abduction Monitoring & Prediction System) - data ingestion manifest
method: All downloads via curl (Bash) with polite 1s delays; HTML parsed with python3 (stdlib only); normalized JSON/CSV written under /home/z/my-project/data/. NO fabricated data: every row traces to a fetched source.

files.format: CSV (all 52 original UCDP GED columns retained)
files.license: Free for scholarly/reference use; cite Sundberg & Melander (2013) JPR 50(1); HEG by Pettersson, Högbladh & Öberg
files.notes: Upgraded from v23.1: coverage 1989-2025, 118 events added for 2023-2025. Country_id 501 (Gleditsch-Ward).

files.rows_or_features: 1 summary object (events_total, by_type, by_year, deaths totals)
files.notes: by_type: statebased 261, nonstate 561, onesided 304. Peak years: 2008 (117), 2017 (107), 2014 (85).

files.source: Wikipedia 'List of counties of Kenya by population' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_counties_of_Kenya_by_population; wikitext fetched via MediaWiki API, cites KNBS 2019 census Vol I + citypopulation.de) merged with Wikipedia 'Counties of Kenya' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Counties_of_Kenya) for code, capital, area, former province, 2022 registered voters
files.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikipedia); underlying data KNBS 2019 Kenya Population and Housing Census (public)
files.notes: CROSS-CHECK PASSED: sum of 47 county population2019 = 47,564,296, exactly the official 2019 census total (0.000% difference); sum population2009 = 38,610,097 also exact. population2023 (citypopulation.de estimates via same table) sums to 51,210,285 vs 51,525,702 shown in the table's total row (total row uses a different source) - use 2019 as canonical denominators. Discrepancy noted: Wikipedia 'Counties of Kenya' table shows Turkana 2019=1,504,976, inconsistent with KNBS census 926,976 used here (KNBS value used because the ranking table passes the official-total cross-check).

files.source: mikelmaron/kenya-election-data counties.geojson - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mikelmaron/kenya-election-data/master/data/counties.geojson (HTTP 200, 1.32MB); provenance per repo README: IEBC (vote.iebc.or.ke) boundaries
files.license: No LICENSE file in repo; data derived from Kenya IEBC electoral boundaries (public-sector data). Treated as public reference use with attribution.
files.notes: 1.25MB (<2MB, no simplification needed). Source file had 48 features: 47 named counties + 1 null-property sliver (Shape_Area ~1e-5) which was dropped. Properties normalized to {name, countyName, countyCode} matching county-populations.json names exactly (47/47 match); original attributes preserved as orig_* fields. Alternate sources tested: Ohuru-Tech 404, mandla-sm 404, HDX 404; deldersveld topojson not needed.

files.source: Missing Voices (Police Reforms Working Group - Kenya) - https://missingvoices.or.ke (pages fetched: /, /statistics, /voices?page=0..6, /statistics/2020, /statistics/2021, /statistics/2022, /trial-tracker, /about, /jsonapi [404])
files.license: Site content copyright Missing Voices Coalition / PRWG-K (site footer 'Missing Voices © 2026'); data compiled for research/attribution use
files.notes: Real data collected: yearly case totals 2019-2025 (145..125 cases), monthly series (Enforced Disappearances / Killings / Incidents) for 2020-2026 parsed from embedded Drupal/Highcharts configs, prosecution statements (28 court prosecutions all-time; 6/5/4 arrests for 2020/2021/2022), and 200 most recent victim records (2025-06-25..2026-08-15) with name/age/sex/location/mannerOfDeath/date. PARTIAL because: 200-entry cap applied (deeper history exists), 2019 monthly series unavailable (/statistics/2019 404), victim rows lack per-case county/category columns (only aggregate chart series distinguish ED vs killings), and year pages' victim tables are not year-filtered (site bug). Automated weekly refresh since 2026-09-28 (scripts/ingest-missingvoices.mjs): rolling monthly series overlaid from the live charts, victims list re-pulled (210 records as of this refresh).

files.source: Primary news articles fetched and verified with curl (HTTP 200): Al Jazeera (3), BBC News (4), Capital FM Kenya (6), Citizen Digital (2), The Star (3), The Standard (1), KNCHR (1); plus Wikipedia wikitext fetched via API (Kenya Finance Bill protests, 2025 Kenyan protests, 2024/2025 in Kenya, Death of Albert Ojwang, Maverick Aoko) with reference URLs extracted; one AP News reference kept via Wikipedia-verification (AP blocks automated fetch, HTTP 403)
files.license: Facts compiled with source attribution; underlying articles copyrighted by respective publishers (fair-use citation for research)
files.notes: Sept 2026 refresh: Kiprotich abduction added; June 2026 Parliament six named per KNCHR; Kiarie/Oloo/Duba named; KNCHR 35-case Reparations Framework + 11-case protest stats added.

files.source: ReliefWeb v2 API - https://api.reliefweb.int/v2/reports (endpoint reachable; refuses requests)
files.notes: HTTP 403 AccessDeniedHttpException: 'not using an approved appname' for 10 appnames tried (kamps, reliefweb, apidoc, rwapi, kamps-research, reliefweb-api, rwint, rw-widget, ocha, unocha); HTTP 400 without appname; v1 endpoint HTTP 410 decommissioned; website /search 444; /country/kenya HTML 202 empty (bot protection); country RSS returns unfiltered global feed. ReliefWeb now requires pre-registered appnames (Google form per apidoc.reliefweb.int/parameters). No data fabricated; next action documented in the file.

files.source: ACLED Africa aggregated data file, myACLED Open tier (https://acleddata.com/aggregated/aggregated-data-africa), week of 2026-09-12
files.license: ACLED registered access, non-commercial use, attribution required
files.notes: Weekly county-level (Admin 1) event, fatality and exposure counts, 1997-01 to 2026-09-12, all 47 counties. Includes 299 Abduction/forced-disappearance county-week rows. Event-level REST access requires Research Partner tier; OAuth credentials are env-gated for when the tier upgrades.

files.rows_or_features: 54 keyword-matched articles (trailing 60 days); 10 in the last 7 days; KNCHR statement index (latest id 1265)
files.source: Google News RSS (3 queries), Bing News RSS, KNCHR /articles index - all keyless
files.license: per-item publishers of record; headlines and links only, no article bodies
files.notes: Discovery layer, not an incident list: keyword-matched coverage ('abduct', 'kidnap', 'enforced disappearance', 'missing', 'dumped') from two independent search feeds plus the KNCHR press-statement index. Articles are deduplicated by normalized title; counties are matched from headline text. Nothing here counts as an incident until a human verifies and promotes it into incidents-public-record.json. KNCHR ids enable new-statement detection between weekly runs.

files.rows_or_features: 349 daily points / 12 months of article counts; latest month 2026-09: 43 articles
files.source: GDELT DOC 2.0 API, mode=TimelineVolRaw, query 'kenya (abduction OR abducted OR kidnapped OR "enforced disappearance") sourcelang:eng'
files.license: GDELT Project, free API, attribution requested
files.notes: Media-ATTENTION volume, not incidence: language bias, press freedom and news cycles move it. Corroboration context only; deliberately excluded from the risk index. On rate-limited runs the last successful timeline is preserved with an attempt note.

gaps.reason: The myACLED account authenticates (OAuth verified) but sits on the Open tier; event-level REST needs Research Partner tier. The weekly Africa aggregate file (all 47 counties, week x Admin 1 x event type, refreshed Mondays) is the production feed; scripts/ingest-acled.mjs probes the REST path first and auto-upgrades when the tier clears.

403 without a pre-approved appname. Appname requested 2026-09-27 via the official form (kamps-earlywarning-7f3a, review up to 2 business days). scripts/ingest-reliefweb.mjs runs weekly once RELIEFWEB_APPNAME is approved.

gaps.source: Police OB records, hospital/mortuary registries, IPOA aggregates
gaps.reason: Require Access to Information Act 2016 formal requests; documented as the plan Phase 2 MSE inputs but not yet filed. Until they arrive, capture-recapture stays not-estimable and the documented count stands unadjusted.

gaps.source: Nation Africa (Daily Nation) articles; AP News articles
gaps.reason: Nation Africa is paywalled; AP returns 403 to non-browser clients. Their reporting still enters via secondary coverage and Wikipedia reference extraction.

gaps.source: Missing Voices full victim database + 2019 monthly statistics
gaps.reason: Weekly scrape keeps the newest ~210 victim rows (2025-2026 well covered). 2019 monthly series not published on the site; deeper history exists behind manual export.
